SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b with an overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then computes c = a - b, guarding underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): computes c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then returns c = a / b.
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits from, decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits to.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then makes an external call to spender.receiveApproval.
